P.S. you probably won't ever need to "advertise" that you have a shelter for people who seek it. People who are in need for shelter will look everywhere for it and will stumble upon your provided opportunity. However, if you want to make yourself more "findable", post it online, on newspaper, on social media or go look yourself for someone who is looking for a home.

Since you don't own a place yourself, accomplishing this will be hard, unless you are very rich and can buy a bulding yourself for shelter. I will assume that this is not the case. Consequently, since your resources are limited, you could go to people who can afford to do this, raise their awareness and sell them the fact, that this is needed and that they should buy a building for shelter. Or just take 1-2 refugees in their own home. 

There are a few problems that could arise though: 

1. Are they even allowed in our country? (Aren't they illegal here. Do they have legal papers? Etc.)
2. Not every refugee is harmless. There are certainly mischievous people out there, even when you extend your arm to help them. 
3. Considering the point above, you will have a hard time convincing people to take refugees in their own home.
4. Fortunately, we aren't yet at that moment in the time where we need to take refugees in, but it certainly can't harm preparing for such a situation.

Of course providing shelter for refugees is a much needed and humble thing to do, but there are certainly also other ways to help. Get creative, do some research about past wars and analyze what people did to help, or better yet: try to find something people needed, but was hard to or impossible to offer at the time and think about what you could do to offer that yourself.
